basics.name: Yanis Bardes
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Artificial Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay (LISV laboratory), in a CIFRE industrial doctorate with Alten Labs. Research on federated object detection for UAVs under hardware constraints, applied to real-time waste detection. Lecturer at ECE Paris (AI, MLOps, Mathematics) and ESIEE Paris (Big Data, Full-Stack Data Applications).

work.summary: Real-time, continual UAV waste detection using federated learning and multi-objective optimization.
highlights: Hardware-aware federated detection: profiled 17 detectors on a Jetson Orin NX, then compared head-only, head-and-neck and LoRA adaptation under altitude-induced non-IID federated learning
UAV-DiverseWaste: 30,387-image resource from 24 datasets and an Unreal Engine 5 simulation, with the audited D²EW benchmark
Annotation harmonization: waste-item boxes to cleanup units, mAP@0.5 from 0.434 to 0.563
Semi-supervised federated detection with server-side labels

work.summary: Big Data (final-year engineering students, ING5), Full-Stack Data Applications (master's level, international track, taught in English).
Artificial Intelligence (engineering programme, master's level), MLOps (MSc in AI, international track, taught in English), Mathematics (preparatory cycle).
Open-source community for Moroccan Arabic (Darija) AI.
highlights: Preprocessing of Terjman translation data (language identification, filtering)
First LLM fine-tuning trials of Atlas-Chat, later released by MBZUAI Paris and AtlasIA
Contributor to TerjamaBench, a cultural English-Darija translation benchmark

work.summary: Generative AI: Multi-Modal Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) — patented. Document structuring by AI. CI/CD deployments on Azure DevOps.
highlights: Multi-Modal RAG pipeline (LLM, embedding model, vector database, inference engine) — patented
AI document structuring via OCR and LLM
Parallelization of OCR and structuring pipelines
CI/CD deployment on Azure DevOps with Docker and monitoring
